## Pelagos Sea Spider (CR 15)

**XP** 51,200  
N Huge magical beast (aquatic)  
**Init** +8; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, watersense 60 ft.; Perception +31  


**Defense**


**AC** 29, touch 13, flat-footed 25 (+1 dodge, +4 Dex, +16 natural, -2 size)  
**hp** 320 (20d10+120)  
**Fort** +20, **Ref** +16, **Will** +12  
**Resist** acid 10, cold 10, fire 10  


**Offense**


**Speed** Swim 90 ft.  
**Melee** bite +26 (2d8+7 plus poison plus grab), 4 slams +25 (2d6+7)  
**Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** swallow whole (2d6+7 plus 1d8 acid damage, AC 18, 23 hp)  
**Spell-like Abilities** (CL 20th):  

3/day—cone of cold (DC 19), lightning bolt (DC 17) (affects a 30-ft. radius around the pelagos rather than a single target)  
1/day—stinking cloud (DC 17)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 25, **Dex** 16, **Con** 22, **Int** 20, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +20; **CMB** +29 (+33 grapple); **CMD** 44 (56 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Alertness, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Swim-by Attack, Weapon Focus (bite), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Diplomacy +24, Escape Artist +24, Knowledge (nature) +25, Knowledge (religion) +25, Perception +31, Sense Motive +28, Stealth +17 (+25 when floating on the surface) , Swim +20; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Stealth when floating on the surface  
**Languages** Aquan, Common, Draconic, Elven, Sylvan  


**Special Abilities**


**Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; *save* Fort DC 26; *frequency* 1/round for 4 rounds; *effect* 1d3 Con damage; *cure* 2 consecutive saves.
